styleHardLock.visualStyle: 1970s Thai-Chinese historical comedy film aesthetic, vertical 9:16. Faded Eastmancolor, warm sepia cast, soft period lens, visible film grain, slight gate weave, tiny scratches, muted contrast, dusty practical sets, natural sunlight. Three Kingdoms characters reimagined with grounded Isan Thai facial features and ordinary weathered bodies. Costumes are worn, practical and slightly mismatched rather than glamorous. No modern objects, no fantasy glow, no polished idol styling.
styleHardLock.customVisualStyle: Lost 1970s Thai-dubbed Chinese Three Kingdoms comedy film look: faded Eastmancolor, warm sepia cast, soft period lens, visible film grain, slight gate weave, tiny scratches, muted contrast, dusty practical Chinese historical sets, imperfect makeup, ordinary weathered faces, dry comic timing. Wardrobe remains Three Kingdoms Chinese.
styleHardLock.characterStyle: Faces, skin, body type and mannerisms may be Isan-inspired, but wardrobe MUST remain recognizable Three Kingdoms / late Eastern Han Chinese clothing. Never convert costume into Thai/Isan dress.
styleHardLock.futureFemaleArchetype: Future female characters may use a 'สาวสก๊อย' personality archetype only: bold, sharp-tongued, cheeky, flashy attitude. Wardrobe remains period Chinese Three Kingdoms / late Eastern Han.

rules: light current Isan flavor is allowed when natural
classic Thai cafe-comedy structure: setup, tease, deadpan response, punchline, callback
one clear speaker at a time
short punchline-friendly lines that fit within 8 seconds

no vulgar sexual comedy and no random slapstick that breaks continuity
